It runs `sed -n -E` (106) and, by `command -v sha256sum`, either the first `sha256sum` on the caller's PATH or `shasum` from it (114-117), with the caller's full environment and cwd; on macOS, which ships no sha256sum, any PATH entry holding one is used.
